pretreatment: chemimechanically polished, etched for 5 min in 1 yo bromine methanol, and then rinsed in methanol
evidence: The CdTe (111) substrates of the size of about 4 x 6 mm2 were cut from unintentionally doped p-type wafers grown by a modified Bridgman method. They were chemimechanically polished, etched for 5 min in 1 yo bromine methanol, and then rinsed in methanol.
